title: Improving Recommendation Fairness without Sensitive Attributes Using Multi-Persona LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating recommendation fairness by training an attacker model to classify user gender from the learned user embeddings (using AUC to measure sensitive information leakage) and calculating group fairness metrics such as Demographic Parity (DP@20) and Equal Opportunity (EO@20).

Evaluating recommendation fairness by training an attacker model to classify a user's occupation (across 21 distinct categories) from the learned user embeddings, using AUC to measure the leakage of occupational sensitive information.
